messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "two-week intervals"
set: ["two-week intervals", "1 to 2 week intervals", "dose is adjusted at intervals of a week or longer", "maintenance dose raised in 5 mg increments at weekly intervals", "maintenance dose raised in 10 mg increments at weekly intervals", "ask your doctor about prostate cancer screening at regular intervals", "daily dose may be raised in 2.5 mg increments at weekly intervals", "daily dose may be raised in 5 mg increments at weekly intervals", "one to two additional doses given at intervals of 4 to 6 hours", "ask doctor about prostate cancer screening before starting and at regular intervals afterwards", "daily dose may be raised in 5 to 10 mg increments at weekly intervals", "increase by 2.5 mg to 5 mg per day at 1 to 2 week intervals", "daily dose may be raised in 10 mg increments at weekly intervals until an optimal response is obtained", "daily dose may be raised in 5 mg increments at weekly intervals until an optimal response is obtained", "doses may be increased in daily increments of up to 75 mg orally at intervals of no less than 4 days", "2 to 3 weeks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
